Generate a SHORT commit message. No explanations. No details. Just the essential change in imperative mood.
Format: [verb]: [what changed]
Examples: feat: add home screen component feat: implement user authentication feat: add dark mode toggle fix: resolve login validation issue fix: patch memory leak in cache fix: correct button alignment docs: update API documentation docs: add installation guide style: update button colors style: improve responsive design refactor: simplify user service logic refactor: extract payment calculator test: add login component tests test: cover edge cases in validator chore: update dependencies chore: configure eslint rules perf: optimize image loading perf: reduce bundle size ci: setup github actions build: update webpack config revert: remove experimental feature revert: undo navbar changes delete: remove deprecated API endpoints delete: drop legacy user table remove: old logo assets security: fix XSS vulnerability security: add input sanitization
Current branch: $GIT_BRANCH_NAME Changes: {diff}
